ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a schematic diagram of the distribution of isotherms in a certain region. The isotherm labels show that the higher 20℃ isotherm is located in the upper part of the figure, and the lower 10℃ isotherm appears below it and near the lower right. Reasoning: According to the conventional map direction, the upper part is north and the lower part is south, so the temperature in the figure decreases from top to bottom, that is, the temperature decreases toward the south. The direction in which temperature decreases usually points toward high latitudes and near-polar directions; if toward the south is the direction toward the pole, then this region is located in the Southern Hemisphere.

raw_record.question_text:
The following figure schematically shows the distribution of isotherms in a certain region in a certain month. Read the figure and complete:

<image1>

In which hemisphere is this region located?

method.method_draft: First describe the image: note that higher temperature, 20℃, is positioned above the lower 10℃ isotherms. Then infer that temperature decreases downward/southward. Since poleward direction is south only in the Southern Hemisphere, conclude the region is in the Southern Hemisphere.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中为某地区等温线分布示意图，等温线标注显示，较高的20℃等温线位于图的上方，较低的10℃等温线出现在其下方和右下方附近。推理：按常规地图方向，上方为北、下方为南，因此图中气温由上向下递减，即向南气温降低。气温降低的方向通常指向高纬、近极地方向；若向南是趋向极地的方向，则该地区位于南半球。
method.CoT_answer_check_final: 图像描述：图中为某地区等温线分布示意图，等温线标注显示，较高的20℃等温线位于图的上方，较低的10℃等温线出现在其下方和右下方附近。推理：按常规地图方向，上方为北、下方为南，因此图中气温由上向下递减，即向南气温降低。气温降低的方向通常指向高纬、近极地方向；若向南是趋向极地的方向，则该地区位于南半球。
method.CoT_qualify_0: 该推理基本合格：先描述了图像中20℃与10℃等温线的相对位置，再按常规地图上北下南推断气温向南降低，进而判断向南为高纬/近极方向，结论为南半球，与标准答案一致。可小幅改进之处：描述时避免把所有10℃都概括为“其下方”，可更精确说明右侧中部有10℃闭合等温线、右下也有10℃标注；最终可明确写“答案：南半球”。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This route uses the meridional temperature gradient shown by the isotherm labels, not recognition of the coastline or coordinates.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the vertical placement of the isotherms: the 20℃ isotherm is drawn toward the upper/northern part of the map, while 10℃ isotherms occur farther down/south, including near the lower right and around P. Treat the map as north-up.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question statement that the figure is an isotherm distribution map and asks which hemisphere the region is in.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: In middle latitudes, temperature generally decreases from the equator toward the pole. If temperatures decrease from north to south, the equator must lie to the north of the region, which indicates the Southern Hemisphere.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: use the legend to distinguish ocean and land, and read the coordinate labels around 15°E–20°E and 33°. Match the observed west-coast coastline and land/ocean layout to real-world geography, identifying it as southwestern Africa near Cape Town. Since that region lies south of the equator, answer Southern Hemisphere.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图例显示白色表示陆地，斜线阴影表示海洋。图中左侧大片为斜线阴影的海洋，右侧主要为白色陆地，海岸线呈南北向分布在陆地西侧。图下方标有15°、20°经线位置，右侧标有33°纬线；等温线在陆地和海洋附近弯曲分布。
推理：按坐标约15°E—20°E、33°附近，并结合“西侧为海洋、东侧为陆地”的西海岸轮廓，可对应到非洲西南部、开普敦附近地区。开普敦及非洲西南部位于赤道以南，因此该地区位于南半球。

method.CoT_qualify_0: 推理链整体合格：先描述图像要素，再依据经纬度与海陆分布推理位置，最后得出南半球，与标准答案一致。可略微改进之处是：图中经纬度标注本身主要显示为15°、20°、33°，若直接写15°E—20°E，应说明这是结合区域识别或常识判断得到的，以避免看起来像图上明确标有“E”。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This route identifies the mapped region from its coordinate/coastline setting; it is distinct from merely using the north-south temperature gradient.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the graticule and land-sea pattern: bottom labels include 15° and 20° longitudes, the right side marks about 33° latitude, the hatched area is ocean according to the legend, and the coastline places ocean to the west of land near those longitudes.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt only to know that the figure represents a geographic region and the required output is the hemisphere.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: A west-coast landmass near 15°E–20°E and about 33° latitude corresponds to southwestern Africa/Cape region, whose latitude is about 33°S; the analogous 33°N, 15°E–20°E area would not match this coastline-ocean arrangement. Therefore the hemisphere is Southern.
